summary.text: Josh Beaupre is the Democratic candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 105, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Nicole Klarides-Ditria.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said the district's towns of Beacon Falls, Derby and Seymour deserve more than Hartford photo-ops and that he would prioritize infrastructure, small businesses and schools.

paragraphs.text: Josh Beaupre described himself in a Ballotpedia survey as the son of a veteran and said the Naugatuck Valley is his home.
The Democratic primary for the seat was canceled.
He listed the cost of living, protecting seniors and creating good-paying jobs as priorities, and said he is personally passionate about safe and secure housing.
